affected_dispatch: Offline measurement, audition worker and export call ProgrammeGainProcessor using the existing absolute reader frame. No timing, buffering, callback or presentation-clock edits.
fresh_required: M12 processing matrix and affected native regressions; pinned EBU/ITU; one three-hour workflow; independent quantization and silent UI.
reused_historical_evidence: M11 baseline numerical tolerances, pinned vector bytes and immutable long fixture inputs only. Historical video/High Sierra results do not qualify M12.
deferred: Every test loading/decoding/playing video and all actual High Sierra/Golem access until after M13.

selection_audit.composition: --phase safety only; native video requires --phase video
selection_audit.multichannel: default audio-only tests; videoIsolation requires --video; no long-source mode
selection_audit.sessions: --short; serialized rational offsets only; no video attachment
selection_audit.programmes: default audio/group regressions plus explicitly derived audio-only M8 sessions; nativeReferences requires both --video and --prores
selection_audit.export: default audio tests; exportVideo requires both --video and --prores
selection_audit.m12-long: SectionProcessingTests --long-session only; input session must have no video; does not call historical longComposition runner
